newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, June 17 - Durres - Seven vessels in port operating, all discharging, of which 4 wheat flour, 1 general cargo, 1 bulk cement, 1 bagged cement. 3 Vessels in roads awaiting berths, all to discharge, of which 2 wheat flour, 1 general cargo.

BULGARIA, June 16 - No labour problems. Varna - Varna east - 8 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load. Varna west - 11 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. Varna Lesport/tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - Bourgas east - 9 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth. 8 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load. 3 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 11 due. Bourgas west - 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Tanker port - 1 Vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik - 51 Vessels in port operating of which 36 loading (3 clinker, 1 frozen chicken/general cargo, 1 cellulose/granite, 1 soda/quartz sand, 1 sas, 10 soda, 5 urea, 3 scrap, 2 kaolin, 1 cement, 1 glass, 2 quartz sand, 1 cigarettes, 2 fertiliser, containers). 8 Discharging (1 granite, 4 phosphorite, 1 rice, 2 containers, 1 coke). 4 Discharging/loading containers, 3 discharging/

Bourgas - 10 Vessels in port operating of which 4 loading (1 ammonium sulphate, 1 ammonium nitrate, 1 machinery, 1 metals). 6 Discharging (1 rice, 1 salt, 1 coal, 1 iron ore, 1 coke, 1 crude oil). 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load (1 copper cathodes, 1 general cargo, 1 oil). 1 To discharge containers, 1 empty vessel. 9 Vessels due of which 7 to load (4 steel, 2 ammonium nitrate, 1 clinker). 2 To discharge (1 coal, 1 general cargo).

CYPRUS, June 17 - Limassol - Five container vessels loading/discharging at berth, 4 conventional vessels discharging. 8 Vessels due 18/6 of which 2 containers, 1 conventional vessel, 5 passenger vessels. Larnaca - One container vessel loading/discharging at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging. 2 Vessels due 18/6 of which 1 containers, 1 conventional vessel.

ESTONIA, June 16 - No labour problems. Tallinn - City port - 3 Vessels loading at berth (1 pig-iron, 1 steel billets, 1 hardboard), 1 liner. 3 Vessels due. Kopli - 1 Sawn timber vessel loading at berth, 1 cocoa bean vessel discharging at berth. 7 Vessels due. Muuga - 5 Vessels loading at berth (2 fuel oil, 1 fertiliser, 1 scrap metal, 1 general cargo). 3 Discharging at berth (1 poultry, 1 barley, 1 general cargo). 4 vessels due.

ITALY, June 17 - Naples - One gas tanker etb 17/6, 1 bulk carrier etb over the next few days. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa - Commercial port - 1 Vessel in roads, no delays. 30 Vessels berthed, 1 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - Delta pier (gasoil/black products and crude) will be under repair from 24/6-4/7. Beta pier (black/white products) is back in operation from 13/6. No vessels in roads, 1 berthed. Savona - Vessels in roads, no delays. 7 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays. 3 Vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays. 8 Vessels berthed, 5 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - 10 Vessels in roads, 43 berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads. Gaeta, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona/Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. Naples - One vessel in roads. Augusta - Oil harbour - 1 Vessel in roads, 1 berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - 1 Vessel in roads, 1 berthed. Sarroch - Four vessels in roads, 4 berthed. Taranto, Ravenna, Venice - No delays. Triest

LATVIA, June 17 - No strikes at any port. Riga - 21 Vessels in port of which 18 operating as follows, 4 timber loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 container loaders, 2 tanker loaders, 2 steel loaders, 2 fertiliser loaders, 3 frozen food dischargers, 2 sugar dischargers. 3 Other general cargo vessels waiting. No delays, 20 vessels due. Ventspils - Three vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 MOP loader, 1 ferrous metal loader, 1 miscellaneous. 4 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage. No delays, 10 vessels due.

LITHUANIA, June 17 - Klaipeda - 13 Vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (1 oil, 1 cement, 1 metal, 1 steel coils, 2 scrap). 6 Discharging (1 fish, 1 fish meal, 1 pellets, 1 malt, 2 sugar), 1 loading/discharging. 1 Vessel in roads, 36 due.

POLAND, June 17 - Szczecin - 31 Vessels loading at berth, 38 discharging at berth. 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge, 8 under repair/dry-docked, 72 due. Gdynia - 14 Vessels operating of which 9 loading at berth (8 general cargo, 1 bulker). 5 Discharging at berth (3 general cargo, 2 grain). 3 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 40 due. Gdansk - 12 Vessels operating of which 9 loading at berth (5 bulkers, 2 general cargo, 1 coal, 1 tanker). 3 Discharging at berth (1 general cargo, 2 grain). 4 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 21 Vessels due.

PORTUGAL, June 16 - Leixoes - Eight vessels operating of which 5 general cargo, 3 containers. No vessels waiting. Vacant places, 10 piers with cranes, 2 without cranes. Lisbon - 76 Vessels in port of which 1 loading at berth, 14 discharging at berth, 5 loading/discharging at berth, 5 loading at anchorage, 2 discharging at anchorage. 2 Vessels bunkering, 18 under repair/dry-docked, 4 awaiting orders, 24 miscellaneous vessels, 14 due. Sines - Four vessels in port operating of which 2 discharging (1 crude oil, 1 rice). 2 Loading (1 butadiene, 1 butane/propane). No vessels waiting. 8 Vessels due of which 6 to discharge (4 coal, 1 crude oil, 1 propane). 2 To load (1 gasoil/gasoline, 1 unleaded gasoline). Setubal - June 17 - 13 Vessels in port of which 3 loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/dry-docked. 10 Vessels due of which 5 to discharge, 4 to load, 1 for repair/dry-dock.

SPAIN - Aviles - Eight vessels in port of which 2 discharging (1 bauxite, 1 blende). 6 Loading (2 steel products, 1 ammonium nitrate, 1 clay, 1 zinc, 1 cement). Gijon - Eight vessels in port of which 2 discharging (1 cement, 1 timber). 6 Loading (1 cement, 4 steel products, 1 sugar). No delays/congestion/strikes at either port. June 17 - Cadiz - 22 Vessels operating of which 3 ro/ro's, 1 cement, 1 molina, 1 wheat, 1 cotton, 1 wood, 1 ship-building materials, 13 under repair, no delays. - Pasajes - Holiday 17/7. 20 Vessels in port of which 13 discharging (3 scrap, 1 coils, 1 grain, 2 steel, 1 petcoke, 3 granite, 2 china clay). 1 Loading/discharging cars, 3 loading (2 steel, 1 general cargo). 3 Vessels under repair, no delays.

TURKEY, June 17 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 7 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 1 dry cargo, 2 ro/ro's, no berthing delays. Galata - 9 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 11 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. Mersin - 20 Vessels operating of which 3 loading (1 cement, 1 glass, 1 soda). 12 Discharging (1 iron, 1 sugar, 1 pyrites, 1 rails, 1 containers, 2 wheat, 1 pvc, 1 general cargo, 1 sodium sulphate, 1 soda, 1 bulk soda). 5 Loading/discharging (1 vehicles, 1 containers/general cargo, 2 containers, 1 vehicles/containers). No vessels at free zone piers. Seka - One vessel discharging fertiliser.

UKRAINE, June 16 - Mariupol - Nine vessels in port operating of which 7 loading (3 steel, 2 sulphate, 1 coal, 1 fire-clay), 1 loading/discharging containers, 1 cargo unknown. 6 Vessels waiting in roads, all to load, of which 3 steel, 1 sulphur, 2 fertiliser. 38 Vessels due of which 29 to load (3 coal, 7 fertiliser, 1 sulphur, 16 steel, 1 equipment, 1 fire-clay). 6 To discharge (2 equipment, 1 fertiliser, 3 containers). 3 To discharge/load containers. Odessa - 14 Vessels in port operating of which 10 loading (4 metal, 2 fertiliser, 1 cars, 1 paper, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 crude oil). 1 Awaiting owners notification, 3 under repair, 4 in roads of which 1 to load urea, 2 to discharge sugar, 1 waiting. 23 Vessels due of which 13 to load (9 metal, 1 containers, 1 barley, 1 fertiliser, 1 crude oil). 7 To discharge (2 diesel oil, 4 containers, 1 bananas). 1 To discharge/load containers, 2 passenger vessels.

Ilychevsk - Seven vessels in port operating of which 5 loading (3 steel, 1 potash, 1 pig-iron). 2 Discharging/loading containers. 3 Vessels waiting in roads, all to load, of which 1 debars, 2 pig-iron. 13 Vessels due of which 9 to load (1 debars, 3 equipment, 1 pig-iron, 4 steel). 1 To discharge cars, 3 to discharge/load containers. June 17 - Mariupol - Eight vessels loading at berth (4 metal products, 1 clay, 1 sulphur, 1 fertiliser, 1 coal). Discharging at berth (both general cargo), 9 vessels waiting at anchorage to load (5 metal products, 3 sulphur, 1 fertiliser). 1 Waiting to discharge general cargo, 1 vessel under repair/dry-docked. 10 Floating storehouses of which 8 fertiliser, 2 sulphur. 31 Vessels due by 17/7 of which 24 to load (7 fertiliser, 13 metal products, 2 coal, 1 clay, 1 general cargo). 5 To discharge (4 containers, 1 general cargo), 2 to discharge/load containers. Kerch - One vessel loading ore at berth, 1 discharging fish, 1 waiting at anchorage to load metal products. 2 Vessels under
